verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing describes close-acceleration features: one-click accrual booking to "close the books every day," automated GL coding by entity, and AI-powered invoice entry and approval. However, these are brief marketing claims, and the accrual and GL-coding automation is never explicitly described as AI-driven. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on how AI drives the close workflow (reconciliation, accrual logic, GL-coding accuracy), explicit AI attribution for the close features, and independent or hands-on corroboration that close time is reduced.
